//: Config for driving the REAL UR5e. ONE server: run_vision_root.sh launches case 1/server.py with UR_VISION=1, which mounts case 4's camera tools into it, so motion and vision arrive as a single 'ur-tools' MCP. It runs under sudo because librealsense needs root for the D435 on macOS; the host (192.168.1.100) is the ARGUMENT because sudo strips env, and it pins UR_MODEL=ur5e inside the wrapper. To activate: run the preflight (case 1/preflight_real_robot.py <ip>), copy this over .mcp.json, restart Claude Code. Flip back with mcp.simulator.json (or git checkout .mcp.json).
